buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Scope of Supply The bidder shall supply 80 (Eighty) Reams of A4 Size, 75 GSM Plain Copier Paper for official use at the Regi onal Office, NSO (FOD), Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar. 2. Technical Specifications The paper supplied shall strictly comply with the following specifications: a. Paper Size: A4 (210 mm × 297 mm). b. Grammage: 75 GSM.

c. Colour: Bright White (Pure White) with uniform whiteness throughout the paper. Dull White, Off-White, Cr eamish or Yellowish paper shall not be accepted. d. Quality Standard: The paper shall conform to the latest applicable BIS standard for Plain Copier Paper, i. e. IS 14490:2024, and shall bear a valid BIS/ISI certification mark, wherever applicable. e. Brightness: The paper shall meet the applicable brightness requirements prescribed under the relevant BIS standard. f. Opacity: The paper shall have adequate opacity to ensure clear printing and minimum show-through dur ing double-sided printing. g. Surface Quality: The paper shall have a smooth, uniform and dust-free surface, free from spots, stains, wrinkles, holes and other visible defects. h. Printing Compatibility: The paper shall be suitable for regular use in high-speed photocopiers, laser print ers and inkjet printers without frequent paper jams, curling or excessive paper dust. 3. Quantity and Packaging a. Total Quantity: 80 (Eighty) Reams. b. Each ream shall contain exactly 500 sheets of A4-size paper. c. Each ream shall be properly sealed and packed in moisture-resistant packaging to prevent damage due to moisture, dust or other external factors. d. The packaging shall clearly indicate the manufacturer's name, brand, paper size, GSM and number of sh eets. 4. Quality Inspection and Acceptance a. The purchaser reserves the right to inspect and verify the quality of the supplied material before accept ance. b. The supplied paper shall strictly conform to the technical specifications mentioned in this ATC. c. The purchaser reserves the right to reject the entire consignment or any portion thereof if the paper is fo und to be of inferior quality, dull white, discoloured, damaged or otherwise not conforming to the prescribe d specifications. d. In case of rejection, the supplier shall replace the rejected material with fresh material conforming to the required specifications, at no additional cost to the purchaser. 5. Delivery Conditions a. The supplier shall ensure delivery of the entire quantity of 80 reams at the consignee's office within the delivery period specified in the GeM contract. b. All expenses towards transportation, loading, unloading and replacement of rejected material shall be b orne by the supplier. c) The supplier shall ensure complete door delivery of the ordered material up to the designated place insi de the office premises. Delivery limited to the main gate or entrance of the office premises shall not be co nsidered as complete delivery and shall not be accepted by the purchaser. The supplier shall be responsibl e for unloading, carrying and placing the supplied material at the designated location inside the office pre mises. All expenses related to transportation, unloading, handling and internal shifting of the material shall be borne entirely by the supplier. No additional charges whatsoever shall be payable by the purchaser or t he office for such services. 6. General Conditions a. The bidder shall ensure that the product offered and supplied is in accordance with all the technical spe cifications prescribed in this bid. b. No deviation from the prescribed technical specifications shall be permitted without prior written approv al of the purchaser. c. The purchaser reserves the right to take appropriate action in accordance with the applicable GeM term
s and conditions in case of supply of substandard or non-conforming material. .
